frame: Rater frame: walk the transaction lifecycle. A binding counts only if another layer or rail can verify it. Connectivity is not interoperability. Recoverability requires a forum and a consequence usable at the commerce seam, not a product that exists somewhere else.

C.promise: Scoped signed mandates solve L4 commitment.
C.evidence: Intent/Cart Mandates as W3C VCs; chain of evidence in blog.
C.failure: Revocation not propagated into settlement; signature ≠ execution.

I.promise: Payment-agnostic; binds to A2A, MCP, UCP, x402.
I.evidence: A2A x402 extension; UCP spec binds AP2 mandates.

A.promise: 4/7 assurance properties via mandates and audit trail.
A.evidence: VC mandates; chain of evidence; price consent.
A.failure: No finality, compliance, or recoverability artifact.

EM.promise: Reduces platform trust via signed mandates; stablecoin option.
EM.failure: Still needs settlement rail; no legal enforcement.

S.failure: No versioned spec or named governance.

C.promise: Solves L5 payment authorization/settlement: HTTP 402, payment proof, facilitator settlement.
C.evidence: x402.org spec, PAYMENT-SIGNATURE, on-chain settlement, CAIP-2 networks, production facilitators.
C.failure: No atomic bind of delivery to finality; payment != delivery (T3).
C.metric: On-chain settled txs match 402 requests; delivery not covered.

I.promise: Propagate payment guarantee across Web2 HTTP and Web3 rails via CAIP-2 and multi-chain SDKs.
I.evidence: EVM/Solana/Algorand SDKs; facilitator signature; A2A/AP2 extension.
I.failure: Facilitator is trusted/semi-trusted; proof verified via facilitator, not directly on-chain by merchant.
I.metric: Independent verifiers per chain; signature verification path.

A.promise: Addresses 5/7 assurance properties with observable artifacts.
A.evidence: Payment proof, exact/upto, Permit2, on-chain finality, audit receipts drafts.
A.failure: No compliance or recoverability in base; receipts optional/draft.
A.metric: 5 properties observable; compliance and recoverability absent.

EM.promise: Works without banks, KYC, courts, or commerce platform via crypto payments.
EM.evidence: No account/KYC; stablecoins; direct HTTP; on-chain settlement.
EM.failure: Needs trusted facilitator; no legal recourse on dispute.
EM.metric: Dependencies on five institutions; facilitator reliance.

S.promise: Versioned public spec governed by Linux Foundation with multiple implementations.
S.evidence: x402.org; LF x402 Foundation; Stripe/Cloudflare/AWS/Alchemy; TS/Go/Python SDKs.
S.failure: IETF drafts not final; marketing metrics unverified.

C.promise: Order lifecycle objects close incomplete contracts
C.evidence: Order, fulfillment, refund objects in spec-ucp

I.promise: Bindings to AP2/A2A/MCP propagate state across seams

A.promise: Assurance for auth, execution, auditability, refunds
A.evidence: AP2 mandates; order objects; webhooks; refund adjustments
A.failure: No economic finality or compliance continuity in UCP

EM.promise: None for missing institutions; relies on PSP/cards/banks
EM.evidence: Business remains MoR; finality PSP/card/bank; continue_url
EM.failure: No usable artifact where cards/courts/banks weak

S.evidence: spec-ucp with version dates; GitHub; endorsements
S.failure: No named governance; lodging/food specs incomplete

C.promise: Solve adverse selection with verified identity and behavioral reputation.
C.evidence: EIP-8004 defines three registries (identity, reputation, validation).
C.failure: Capability claims not cryptographically guaranteed; Sybil inflation remains.
C.metric: Draft spec; no deployed singleton; score 1.

I.promise: Propagate agent trust across layers and web2-web3.
I.evidence: Registries list A2A/MCP/ENS/DID/wallet endpoints; optional x402 flag.
I.failure: Reputation per-registry; no cross-chain consistency or settlement binding.

A.promise: Assurance coverage for seven commerce properties.
A.evidence: Only reputation/validation on-chain records; audit trail.
A.failure: No authorization, execution, finality, pricing, compliance, or recovery.

EM.promise: Work without courts, cards, banks, or platform trust.
EM.evidence: Permissionless identity registry on-chain; no KYC/card dependency.
EM.failure: No currency stability or legal enforcement mechanism; draft only.
EM.metric: Reduces dependence on formality but lacks deployed artifact; score 1.

S.promise: Stable, governed standard for agent trust.
S.evidence: Public EIP-8004 draft; authors from EF, MetaMask, Google, Coinbase.
S.failure: Draft status; no canonical mainnet singleton or independent implementations cited.
S.metric: Public EIP draft, not final; score 1.

C.failure: Advertised capability not bound to demonstrated performance

I.failure: Connectivity without verifiable binding to other layers

A.evidence: trust_model; traces noted in ledger L3
A.failure: No scope enforcement or full audit

C.promise: Agent Card and Task lifecycle address discovery and effort.
C.evidence: Spec defines Agent Card, Task, Message/Part/Artifact.
C.failure: Capability claims and traces unvalidated; intent fidelity open.
C.metric: No checkable metric for capability validation.

I.promise: Interoperability via standard HTTP/SSE and multi-vendor SDKs.
I.evidence: Linux Foundation TSC; SDKs in 6 languages; UCP uses Agent Card URL.
I.failure: No auditable binding to payment or settlement rail.
I.metric: Number of verified cross-layer bindings remains unspecified.

A.promise: Task traces support audit of agent exchanges.
A.evidence: Task lifecycle and artifacts observable; auth declared on Agent Card.
A.failure: No consent/mandate scope, payment finality, or recovery.

EM.promise: Institution-light agent communication over the web.
EM.evidence: No bank/court/card dependency; peer-to-peer with arbitrary auth.
EM.failure: Still needs fallback payment/identity layer for commerce.
EM.metric: Direct dependency count on listed institutions is zero.

S.evidence: Linux Foundation project; TSC includes AWS, Google, IBM, Microsoft, etc.; 6 SDKs.

C.promise: Stream agent state and UI intents to reveal agent actions to user.
C.evidence: Event-based protocol with streaming chat, thinking-step visualization, custom events.
C.failure: Interface success can hide weaker seams; no enforceable remedy.
C.metric: Documented event types; no checkable metric for revelation.

I.promise: Interoperate with MCP/A2A as agent-user layer.
I.evidence: Framework integrations (LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK, Microsoft Agent Framework) and SDKs.
I.failure: No specified auditable binding to another layer or rail.

A.promise: Supports user consent and observability via interrupts and event stream.
A.evidence: HITL approve/edit/retry, custom events, shared state in docs.
A.failure: No enforcement for economic finality, pricing, compliance, recovery.

EM.promise: Works without formal courts or platform trust via transparent UI.
EM.evidence: User-visible agent state and steering controls.
EM.failure: Still needs payment rail; no remedy for loss in weak institutions.
EM.metric: Reduces platform trust dependence; no artifact for bank/legal/ID.

S.promise: Stable open protocol with multiple implementations.
S.evidence: Many SDKs and framework integrations on docs; GitHub repo.
S.failure: No versioned spec or named governance body in evidence.
S.metric: Number of languages/frameworks; no independent adoption census.

C.evidence: Live Court, Escrow, Curate; ERC-792/ERC-1497; appeals
C.failure: Days-scale latency; not agent-speed; no native L8 integration
C.metric: No measured resolution time in corpus; agent-speed SLA absent

I.promise: ERC-792 arbitrator binding for arbitrable contracts
I.failure: Not wired into AP2/x402/UCP; optional, not default
I.metric: Zero agentic protocols using ERC-792 as default in packet

A.evidence: ERC-1497 evidence; Escrow holds funds; Court appeals
A.metric: 4/7 properties addressed (partial exec; yes econ, audit, recover)

EM.promise: Dispute resolution without courts, banks, or formal ID
EM.evidence: Crypto escrow; PoH; pseudonymous jurors; no KYC bureau
EM.failure: Currency volatility; off-chain enforcement needs escrow fallback
EM.metric: Institutional dependence: no court/bank/ID; needs crypto stability

S.failure: Single-vendor implementation; no independent implementers shown
S.metric: Independent implementer count beyond Kleros not documented
